events.title: Demo v0.2.4 : Update in-game tips
events.summary: We've expanded the short tips for your first journeys. They appear when relevant and highlight the objects you need, helping you understand routes, crew combinations and the condition of your train. What's changed Maps and junctions. Step-by-step tips help you open the map with M, select a reachable chamber with an event you want to visit, and apply your route. Your first junction also introduces direction selection with A/D. events.title: Demo Update v0.2.3: Difficulty Options and Tips for Your First Runs
events.summary: Hi everyone! We've been watching your playthroughs and noticed that it's easy to miss a few important things on your first runs: creating a synergy, installing a ram, or spotting a bomber in time. This update helps you learn the ropes and find a challenge that suits you. events.title: Demo v0.2.2: changelog
events.summary: \Starting soldier: a new game lets you pick 1 of 3 base classes (Automatic gunner / Machinist / Frost alchemist). The soldier joins the locomotive crew slot for free on L1; the choice is kept when you restart the run.Synergy reactions: 10 reactions between elements of two different active synergies (fire, frost, electricity, poison, shrapnel).
